name: The Last Job
source:
An Assassin is asked to terminate the President in order to make enough money for retirement.

This short Game branches into different areas and plot based on your choices. Learn about the Assassin's personal history, and handle skeezy characters along the way.

[From [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/the-last-job]Itch.io[/url]]
